name: Sting’s Savor
body:
Price 45 gp; Weight —

ABOUT

The “sting” administered to willing recipients at some temples helps nervous visitors relax. Black-market alchemists have reverse-engineered the drug to meet demand from less savory individuals who appreciate the pliability it elicits in users.

DETAILS

Type injury; Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 15

EFFECT

The user immediately heals 1d8+2 points of nonlethal damage.

EFFECT

After 1d4 hours an opponent who attempts a Bluff check to fool the user or a Diplomacy check to change the user’s attitude can roll twice and take the better result.

DAMAGE

1d2 Wis damage
